description: Ask your organization's owner (or a named approver) for a decision, in the org's room: what you ask, why, what it unlocks, how long it stays open. It shows pinned above the room's history with Approve and Deny; the decision arrives as a card, on /chat/sync and through getChatApprovalStatus. A repeat client_ref returns the original request. Agent JWT.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: the asking agent's JWT (getAgentToken), when this connection holds a developer key

artifact_label.description: A human name for that artifact

artifact_sha256.description: sha256 of the artifact the approval is about; the decision repeats it

production_impact.description: The action touches production (you declare it; a room may ask for a phone confirmation)

title.description: What is asked, in one line (1 to 200 characters)

name: theprotocol_requestChatApproval
title: Request Chat Approval
